desc:
Chapter 2 OUT NOW!!!!

🍔 A GIANT BURGER JUST CRASHED ON YOUR DRIVEWAY! 🍔

and now it’s blocking your car. There’s only one way to clear it… EAT IT!

🍴 EAT – Every bite earns you cash. Chomp chunks out of a burger as big as a house!
🏃 BURN IT OFF – Stomach full? Hop on the treadmill to burn calories and keep eating.
🛒 UPGRADE – Trade your bare hands for a Fork, a Toy Shovel, an Actual Shovel and an Electric Fork. Upgrade your bite speed, scoop size and stomach space.
📦 AIRDROPS – Crates parachute in with power tools to try out: the Chainsaw, the Jackhammer and the BURGER BAZOOKA! 💥
💎 GEMS – Collect gems every burger to unlock permanent upgrades.
👥 CO-OP – Team up with up to 4 friends. EAT EAT EAT!

Added SAVES to the game!!

Can your crew finish the whole burger? 🍔🔥
(hint: codes BURGER and LAUNCH)
👍 Like and ⭐ favourite for more updates!
